name: voice-cast
description: Local Russian speech-to-speech app for talking with cartoon characters on Apple Silicon.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n web,voice,llm -c cyan,green,magenta "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:voice" "bun run dev:llm"
scripts.check:voice: node --check server/voice-server.mjs && for f in server/voice/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.lint: biome check package.json biome.json vite.config.ts index.html web/src server
scripts.format: biome format --write package.json biome.json vite.config.ts index.html web/src server
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run check:voice && bun run test
